name: Frosted Melon | Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) | 6x 0.6g
description:
Rove Ice Packs prerolls, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin, expertly rolled and coated in more ice hash. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test up to 50% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls.

Frosted Melon
A perfectly balanced hybrid with a crisp, juicy sweetness and a smooth, easy finish. Ideal for those in-between moments when you want good vibes without losing your spark.

6 pack - 0.6g each | 3.6g
